mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_answer (exam_id, student_id, question_id, student_response, is_graded, obtained_score, grader_id, grade_time, save_time, extra_info) VALUES (#{examId}, #{studentId}, #{questionId}, #{studentResponse}, #{graded}, #{obtainedScore}, #{graderId}, #{gradeTime}, #{saveTime}, #{extraInfo}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE student_response = VALUES(student_response), save_time = VALUES(save_time), is_graded = VALUES(is_graded), obtained_score = VALUES(obtained_score), grader_id = VALUES(grader_id), grade_time = VALUES(grade_time), extra_info = VALUES(extra_info)
mapper.update:
UPDATE student_answer SET is_graded = 1, obtained_score = #{score}, grader_id = #{graderId}, grade_time = NOW(), extra_info =
JSON_OBJECT('comment', #{comment})
CAST(NULL AS JSON)
WHERE answer_id = #{answerId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM student_answer WHERE exam_id = #{examId} AND (is_graded = 0 OR is_graded IS NULL)

SELECT sa.answer_id, sa.exam_id, sa.student_id, sa.question_id, sa.student_response, sa.is_graded, sa.obtained_score, sa.grader_id, sa.grade_time, sa.save_time, sa.extra_info, q.question_id AS q_id, q.question_type, q.difficulty, q.content, q.options, q.answer, q.default_score, pq.question_score FROM student_answer sa LEFT JOIN question q ON sa.question_id = q.question_id LEFT JOIN exam e ON sa.exam_id = e.exam_id LEFT JOIN paper_question pq ON pq.paper_id = e.paper_id AND pq.question_id = sa.question_id WHERE sa.exam_id = #{examId} AND sa.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY sa.answer_id ASC
